subject_definitions:
<Image 1> is the MALE LEAD character reference: his face, hairstyle, medieval-fantasy attire, weapon and
proportions match <Image 1> exactly in every frame.
<Image 2> is the FEMALE LEAD character reference: her face, hairstyle, medieval-fantasy attire, weapon and
proportions match <Image 2> exactly in every frame.
<Image 3> is the SCENE reference: the medieval-fantasy environment — its architecture, terrain, light and
atmosphere follow <Image 3> exactly.

summary:
An 8-second, EXAGGERATED, high-octane fantasy duel in the game / cinematic-animation style — fast,
over-the-top, stylish. The male lead and female lead clash in a burst of speed and power: a violent
weapon impact with a shockwave burst, a slam into a wall / pillar that cracks it, an acrobatic airborne
flip over the other, and a blazing ground-shattering finisher that ends in a charged standoff, dust and
magical sparks flying. Realistic-CG game-cinematic look. No dialogue.

detailed_description:
High-end realistic-CG, game-cinematic style — exaggerated physicality, dynamic action poses, speed lines /
motion energy, impact shockwaves, glowing magic flare, dust and debris, film grain, dramatic lighting.
The environment is exactly as in <Image 3>; both characters keep their exact appearance and weapons as in
<Image 1] / <Image 2> throughout — no drift, no morphing.

A single continuous shot of approximately 8 seconds, no cuts. The camera is DYNAMIC and follows the
action with energy — a fast, smooth action-cam that tracks the combatants and pushes in on the big
impacts, with slight speed-of-action feel — but it never loses both fighters and never cuts away
mid-move; moves stay readable and physical.

Combat timeline (exaggerated, explosive, one continuous escalation):
- 0–2s: EXPLOSIVE FIRST CLASH. They launch at each other at speed from opposite sides and collide mid-air
  or on the ground with a VIOLENT weapon impact — a blinding flash / shockwave ring bursts from the
  contact, dust and sparks erupt, the ground cracks under their feet. Both are pushed back, skidding,
  weapons scraping.
- 2–3.5s: POWER SLAM. The female lead recovers instantly and launches a huge overhand strike; the male
  lead crosses his weapon to block but is DRIVEN BACK and SLAMMED against a wall / pillar behind him,
  cracking the stone, debris falling around him — he grits his teeth and shoves her off.
- 3.5–5.5s: ACROBATIC FLURRY. The fight goes vertical and fast — she flips / leaps over him mid-combat
  and comes down striking from above; he spins and meets it; they trade a rapid, dazzling series of
  blows with motion blur and speed energy, sparks raining with each clash, bodies twisting through
  dynamic, exaggerated poses — fluid, weightless-feeling, stylish game choreography.
- 5.5–8s: BLAZING FINISHER & STANDOFF. She plants her foot and unleashes a powerful finishing strike that
  the male lead meets head-on with a massive impact — a blazing shockwave / energy burst explodes between
  them, kicking up a wall of dust and magical light; they both stand through it, weapons locked or blades
  crossing at each other's throat, breathing hard, eyes blazing, the dust and sparks settling around
  them in a charged freeze — ending on this dramatic, cinematic standoff.

Keep every motion exaggerated but physically continuous — powerful, fast, with clear weight and impact;
no teleporting, no sliding without cause, no rubber-limb unnaturalness. Both fighters' faces show fierce,
determined intensity. The scene stays exactly as <Image 3] and both fighters stay exactly as <Image 1] /
<Image 2] in every frame.

overall_soundscape:
Massive metallic clashes with deep impact booms, shockwave whooshes, cracking stone, skidding metal,
explosive energy bursts, heavy battle cries / grunts, a roaring ambient wind of the fantasy scene. No
dialogue.

non_diegetic_music:
A thunderous, epic orchestral action score with pounding percussion and brass, surging through each
escalation and cutting to a deep, held low note on the final charged standoff.
